The '''14th Sector Fleet''' was a [[Sector fleet/Legends|Sector Fleet]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Ralchio Nervi/Legends|Ralchio Nervi]] served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the 14th Sector Fleet before coming to the attention of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik]] and was promoted to [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of his own [[Ralchio Nervi's task force/Legends|task force]] prior to the [[Battle of Xorrn/Legends|Battle of Xorrn]].<ref name="Friends" />
